revisions.description: Uploads a workspace file to a SharePoint document library through Microsoft Graph; a file over 4 MB goes through a resumable upload session. The app registration needs the Sites.ReadWrite.All or Files.ReadWrite.All application permission, or Sites.Selected with a grant on the site.

params.label: Tenant ID
params.helpertext: Defaults to the tenant ID the workspace's Microsoft integration shares; or enter the Directory (tenant) ID of an Entra app registration
params.name: tenantId

params.label: Client ID
params.helpertext: Defaults to the client ID the workspace's Microsoft integration shares; or enter the app registration's Application (client) ID
params.name: clientId

params.label: Client Secret
params.helpertext: Defaults to the client secret the workspace's Microsoft integration shares; or enter one of the app registration's. The task gets its own app-only Microsoft Graph token with it
params.name: clientSecret

params.label: Site
params.helpertext: The site's URL (any page under the site will do) or its Graph site ID
params.name: site

params.label: Document Library
params.helpertext: The library's name, e.g. Documents. Blank is the site's default library
params.name: library

params.label: File
params.helpertext: The workspace file to upload, absolute or relative to /workspace
params.name: filePath

params.label: Folder
params.helpertext: The folder in the library, e.g. Releases/2026. Created if missing. Blank is the library's root
params.name: folder

params.label: File Name
params.helpertext: The name in SharePoint. Blank keeps the file's own name
params.name: fileName

results.description: The file's name in SharePoint, which differs from File Name after a rename
results.name: name
